# Firecracker

`firecracker` · openapi · version `1.18.0` · **drafts** · readiness `discovered`

Firecracker's microVM API (Swagger 2.0, release v1.18.0): machine config, boot source, drives, network interfaces, actions, snapshots, balloon, metrics, logger, MMDS, vsock, entropy, pmem, memory hotplug and serial. The API is served only on each microVM's Unix domain socket (--api-sock), without authentication and without a TCP listener, so this entry has no endpoint: reach it through Ragentic's firecracker infra connector or a device host (curl --unix-socket over SSH). Independent integration; not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon Web Services or the Firecracker project.

- [ ] external references: Pinned to release v1.18.0 (commit eaf83bb718a5); Source SHA-256 is of firecracker.yaml at that commit. See provenance.normalization for the YAML-to-JSON step., Transport: Unix domain socket only (--api-sock), one per microVM; no TCP endpoint, no TLS, no credential. Access control is the socket file's permissions on the host. The document's host "localhost" is a placeholder., Works: discovery, schema and operation preview; calls made by a device connector on the KVM host with curl --unix-socket <api-sock> http://localhost/<path>, or by Ragentic's infra connector with driver firecracker (Req unix_socket: on the node, curl --unix-socket through a device via; docs/infra.md in ragentic-io/ragentic)., Does not work: Set up connection as an app connector. The registry accepts only an https endpoint and Ragentic's OpenAPI protocol has no unix-socket base URL, so no endpoint is declared and no TCP endpoint is invented. A loopback socket-to-HTTP relay (e.g. socat) would be unauthenticated; it is not recommended and not covered by this entry., State-changing (gate on approval): only the 10 GET operations are safe; all 30 PUT/PATCH operations are safe: false, notably createSyncAction (InstanceStart, SendCtrlAltDel, FlushMetrics), loadSnapshot, createSnapshot, patchVm (pause/resume), putMmds/patchMmds and the pre-boot device and machine configuration., Not tested against a running Firecracker.
